next_step_summary: The canonical Surya viability benchmark remains active, but actual provider execution is temporarily deferred by explicit product-owner instruction until client-side normalization is completed in three bounded exceptions. PR #193 was closed without merge and superseded. PR #194 implements only ocr-local-contrast-text-mask-v1. After merge, the next authorized exception is ocr-text-angle-estimator-v1, followed by ocr-content-region-bounds-v1. These exceptions must not add crop/deskew application, Surya/provider calls, Android upload, real contracts, encryption, PII masks, Gemini calls or permanent storage unless separately authorized.
